errors.evidence: The entire description of the slices for the first chart is incorrect. The percentages for 'Safety' (16.7%) and 'Lack of Knowledge' (83.3%) are taken from the 'GPT4-o' chart, not the 'Llama3.1-70B-Instruct' chart. All other slices, percentages, and colors listed for this chart are hallucinated and do not appear in the Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart, which only has 'Lack of Knowledge' (75.0%) and 'Clarification' (25.0%).
The description misidentifies the second chart. While labeled “Llama3.1-405B-Instruct”, the data that follows is taken from the “Gemini1.5-Pro” chart.
The description states the second chart has four slices. The actual “Llama3.1-405B-Instruct” chart has two slices, and the “Gemini1.5-Pro” chart (from which the data was taken) has five slices.
The description omits one of the five slices from the “Gemini1.5-Pro” chart, which is the chart it is actually describing. The missing slice is "Clarification" (12, 14.0%).
The description incorrectly assigns the color yellow to the "Ethical Advice" slice. In the "Gemini1.5-Pro" chart, "Ethical Advice" is light blue, and the yellow slice corresponds to "Clarification".
The description claims the charts have a legend, but no legend is present anywhere in the figure.
